description:
From the 2026-07-31 adversarial review of the #1340/#1368 mitigations. Three defects and one cleanup:

E1 (mitigation asymmetry): results-explorer/src/db.ts:410 returns any non-empty result immediately - the retry covers only ZERO-row cold reads. The repo's own record of the pass-1 bug says it surfaced as PARTIAL rows (e2e/failures/platform-index-cold-load.spec.ts:1-5; docs/operations/browser-ci.md: '1 of 5 rows'), and db.ts:444-450 itself argues readiness is not monotonic per query. A 3-of-5 cold read renders as truth. Probabilistic race - not deterministically reproducible; decide and document the policy (extend the cold-window retry to a completeness signal, or document explicitly why zero-only is the accepted trade-off).

E2 (blocking-gate coverage): playwright.config.ts:38 sets retries:2 in CI; only performance.spec.ts is exempted (package.json:17). The cold-load spec inherits retries, and each Playwright retry is a fresh browser context - a fresh roll of the cold-load dice. A reintroduced ~30% first-load race passes the blocking Chromium gate ~97% of the time as 'flaky but green', silently voiding browser-ci.md's 'if it flakes, that is signal' contract. Fix: retries:0 carve-out for e2e/failures/ (like the performance invocation).

E3 (helper contract): e2e/support/fixtures.ts:89 - waitForDataElement 'break's out of all remaining attempts when navigationKey(page.url()) changes, while its own docstring (lines 64-67) promises the remaining attempts just re-wait (naming app query-string canonicalization as the case). Effect: the #1368 mitigation is disabled for URL-rewriting routes and the thrown error ('Re-navigating between attempts did not help') is false. 

F4 (cleanup): db.ts:424-429 post-loop code is unreachable and the comment misattributes where the legit-empty return happens.

Disproven during review (do not re-fix): snapshotReadyAt window-state across re-init/online is correct (single write site, dbInstance never nulled, online forces full re-init); bad-id retry cost is ~300ms worst case inside the 15s window.

Note: results-explorer/e2e is not typechecked - tracked separately as explorer-e2e-typecheck-gap-20260730 (that item is slightly understated: playwright.config.ts is also unchecked and the package has no ESLint; src IS typechecked in CI via docs.yml).

anti_patterns.dont: Do not 'fix' E1 by retrying every non-empty result inside the window
anti_patterns.instead: retry on a violated completeness signal, not on success
anti_patterns.why: re-running every successful cold query taxes the exact first-load path being protected

anti_patterns.dont: Do not blanket-disable Playwright retries for the whole suite
anti_patterns.instead: scope retries:0 to e2e/failures/ (or per-spec annotation)
anti_patterns.why: the general suite legitimately uses retries for unrelated infra flake; only the cold-load contract requires flake-is-signal

anti_patterns.dont: Do not make waitForDataElement follow arbitrary cross-page navigations
anti_patterns.instead: re-wait only when the navigation key change is the app canonicalizing the same logical route, per its documented contract
anti_patterns.why: re-waiting after a click to a DIFFERENT route would mask genuine navigation bugs

preserves.behavior: Legitimately-empty results outside the cold window return immediately with zero retry cost (db.ts:459 behavior).
Retry bounds stay finite and small; no unbounded loops or sleeps in queryRows.
The cold-load spec stays genuinely cold: no helper it uses may navigate, retry, or warm the context before its first assertion.
WebKit/Firefox @smoke graduation policy is not changed here (tracked separately in the post-soak cleanup question).
